beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The Great Decoupling asks what remains reliable when impressive output stops proving deep understanding.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: AI assistance can separate an artifact’s quality from the competence that institutions assume produced it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book follows that break through work, education, culture, and delegated judgment.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its constructive direction is to reconnect useful assistance with learning and genuine responsibility.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers can distinguish becoming more productive from remaining able to understand and challenge consequential decisions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An employee can produce a convincing artifact with assistance while understanding only part of its reasoning.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its visible quality no longer tells an institution everything it once assumed about the maker.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book treats this as a change in evidence, responsibility, and the organization of expertise.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A useful result can coexist with uncertainty about who could detect its important failure.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That distinction carries the argument beyond a forecast of which jobs disappear.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The later chapters examine what happens when practice is removed along with routine work.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A profession can consume existing expertise while weakening the pathway that produces its next generation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed right to remain capable concerns learning, explanation, refusal, and real authority to correct.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It does not demand that everyone perform every task alone.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers are asked to inspect the form of delegation rather than accept or reject assistance wholesale.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the first chapter’s account of the separation between output and understanding.
